name: io.github.egocen-vivideo/vivideo
description: AI video via the Vivideo API: agents sign up, buy a plan and make auto or manual videos.

environmentVariables.name: VIVIDEO_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your Vivideo API key (vv_live_...), from Settings > More > API Keys. Optional: without it, the start_signup / login-code tools get one.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer vv_live_... — your Vivideo API key, created in the app under Settings > More > API Keys.
